title: Data Quality Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
As a Quality Engineer II, you will help ensure the quality and reliability of data solutions that support General Mills’ business. You will design and execute data and Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) testing, validate data across systems, and partner with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to deliver trusted insights. Reporting to the Manager – Quality Engineering, you will contribute to test strategy, continuous improvement, and delivery governance in a collaborative Digital and Technology environment.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Design and execute test plans, test strategies, test cases, and test data for data, extract-transform-load (ETL), business intelligence, and related technology solutions.
* Review data models, data mappings, architecture documentation, and requirements to identify test coverage, risks, and validation needs.
* Write and execute SQL queries (inside BigQuery) to validate, reconcile, and compare data across source systems, transformations, and data warehouse targets in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Perform validation of end to end data flow from source to destination including reports (Tableau Reports).
* Perform Data Quality Checks, and document results, defects, evidence, and recommendations.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, data analysts, data engineers and stakeholders to clarify requirements, troubleshoot issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive resolution.
* Use appropriate test automation tools for extract-transform-load validation and identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency.
* Maintain accurate testing documentation, status reports, productivity metrics, escalations, and delivery sign-offs while meeting project milestones and quality standards.
* Contribute to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, stakeholder responsiveness, and a positive, adaptable team environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computers and related fields.
* Experience: 5 to 7 years of experience in software quality engineering, data testing, extract-transform-load (ETL) testing, or a related area.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis abilities.
* Strong understanding of the software development life cycle and multiple software engineering and testing methodologies.
* Proficiency in SQL, database testing, business intelligence testing, and data validation.
* Experience creating test cases and testing documentation from requirements or specifications, including for projects with limited development documentation.
* Familiarity with issue-tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills, attention to detail, self-motivation, and the ability to work accurately in a fast-paced, changing environment.
* Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with peers and stakeholders, with a continuous-improvement mindset and technical agility.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced capability in agile testing, test management, and database testing, including SQL.
* Working knowledge of extract-transform-load processes, test design techniques, and test planning.
* Foundational knowledge of application programming interfaces, artificial intelligence and machine learning, dbt, and Monte Carlo.
* ISTQB certification.
* Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and related services such as BigQuery or Cloud Functions.
* Knowledge of big data concepts, data warehouse structures, extract-transform-load processes, and data architecture principles.
* Basic knowledge of Python programing.
* Exposure to usage of GenAI tools in testing.
* Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines and DevOps methodologies.
* Demonstrated alignment with General Mills values: do the right thing, play to win, grow and inspire, win as a team, and act boldly and move quickly.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Associate Staff Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**👋🏼We're Nagarro.**
We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at a scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18500+ experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!
  
  
**Requirements**
Job Description
  
  

* Experience: 4+years
* Experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or applied AI, including at least 1–2 years of hands-on experience building production-grade LLM applications.
* Expert-level proficiency in React.js for developing scalable, responsive, and reusable frontend applications.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python for AI development, automation, backend services, and API integration.
* Working knowledge of Java for backend services, REST API development, and enterprise application integration.
* Practical experience with LLM providers and APIs, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or equivalent platforms.
* Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, system prompts, structured outputs, JSON schemas, function calling, and tool integration.
* Strong understanding of LLM application development, AI assistants, agentic workflows, and enterprise AI integration.
* Experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience implementing RAG pipelines, including embeddings, document chunking, retrieval tuning, grounding, and vector database integration.
* Experience with at least one vector database or search platform, such as pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, Azure AI Search, or Vertex AI Vector Search.
* Working knowledge of LLM evaluation methodologies, including evaluation datasets, regression testing, and frameworks such as RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo, or LangSmith.
* Experience with FastAPI, Flask, asynchronous programming, Python packaging, and testing frameworks.
* Basic frontend development knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with backend API development experience.
* Knowledge of Shell scripting, Linux fundamentals, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker.
* Exposure to at least one cloud platform such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Basic understanding of Infrastructure Security concepts, including vulnerabilities, patch management, security logs, IAM, and access controls.
* Awareness of responsible AI and security practices, including prompt injection, data leakage, hallucinations, bias, and content filtering.
* Familiarity with SIEM platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel or Splunk, including the ability to write KQL or SPL queries for AI-assisted security detection and investigation.
* Basic understanding of Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and cloud security controls such as Network Security Groups (NSGs), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), IAM policies, and conditional access.
* Understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Bicep for cloud-native AI service deployment and configuration.
* Exposure to data privacy and regulatory requirements applicable in India, including the DPDP Act and RBI IT Risk Framework, particularly in handling personal and sensitive data within AI systems.
* Familiarity with vulnerability management concepts, including CVE, CVSS, EPSS scoring, CISA KEV catalogue, and patch prioritization workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug LLM behavior across prompts, retrieval pipelines, and tool integrations.
* Ability to interpret evaluation metrics, application logs, and security telemetry to improve AI quality, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrated ownership of AI solutions from prototype to production, including evaluation, observability, testing, and documentation.
* Strong learning agility and adaptability to evolving AI models, frameworks, tools, and development practices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
* Certifications such as CISSP, Associate of ISC², CEH, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty, Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), CCSP, or Google Associate Cloud Engineer are preferred.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy LLM-powered features, AI assistants, and intelligent automation solutions for Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) workflows.
* Build AI-driven capabilities for vulnerability summarization, log triage, remediation recommendations, security policy reviews, configuration assessments, and natural-language querying of security data.
* Develop scalable, responsive, and reusable frontend applications using React.js for AI-powered internal tools and dashboards.
* Build and maintain backend AI services and APIs using Python, with Java-based backend development wherever required.
* Integrate LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, and open-source models into enterprise applications.
* Design and optimize prompt templates, system prompts, structured-output schemas, and function-calling workflows.
* Implement end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document chunking, embeddings, vector store integration, retrieval optimization, and response grounding.
* Develop AI agents and tool-calling workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Build evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, and regression test suites to measure LLM accuracy, hallucination rates, response quality, latency, and cost.
* Continuously improve prompt engineering and AI outputs through offline and online evaluations.
* Implement responsible AI and security controls, including prompt-injection protection, PII redaction, output filtering, rate limiting, audit logging, and access management.
* Integrate AI services with vulnerability scanners, ticketing platforms, SIEM solutions, monitoring tools, and other security infrastructure to enable automated workflows.
* Automate AI/ML operations activities such as data preparation, embedding refresh, evaluation runs, health checks, and monitoring using Python and Shell scripting.
* Test, debug, and optimize AI applications to ensure reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Maintain technical documentation, source code repositories, deployment artifacts, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with security, infrastructure, engineering, DevOps, and data teams to translate business requirements into practical AI-driven solutions.
* Apply infrastructure security principles and cloud security controls while designing and deploying AI services.
* Continuously explore emerging LLM models, frameworks, prompting techniques, and evaluation methodologies to improve solution quality and security posture.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Platform Automation Engineer
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
**Job Description**
Platform Automation Developer - Kubernetes, Python, PowerShell & Shell
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore / Mumbai / Noida / Hyderabad / Chennai
  
  
**Experience:**
6+ Years
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced
**Platform Automation Developer**
with strong expertise in Kubernetes, Python, PowerShell, and Shell scripting. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building platform-level automation solutions that enable deployment, configuration, packaging, orchestration, and lifecycle management of applications across Linux, Windows, VM, and containerized environments.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
As a Platform Automation Developer, you will design and develop automation frameworks, orchestration services, deployment tooling, and platform utilities that improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. You will work closely with DevOps, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Application teams to deliver robust automation solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop platform-level automation and orchestration components for deployment, configuration, packaging, and management of application workloads.
* Build automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, Bash/Shell, and related technologies.
* Automate application installation, configuration, service management, environment setup, and health validation processes.
* Develop and maintain container images, Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, and deployment packages.
* Create build, release, and packaging automation for Linux and Windows-based applications.

title: Associate Lead Testing
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
  
  
If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
  
  
**QA Architect / Lead**
**Exp Range :**
8 - 13 Years
  
  
**Job location :**
Mumbai , Bangalore, Trivandrum
  
  
The QA Architect/Lead is responsible for the testing strategy and infrastructure across the entire platform. You will define the four-tier test framework (unit, integration, contract, acceptance), establish the conventions that ensure every spec-defined acceptance criterion has a verifying test, build out the validation infrastructure for parallel-run cutover from the existing Health Data Engine, and lead the load testing campaign that validates the platform's high-volume
  
  
capacity claims.
  
  
This role is technical-lead calibre. You will design test frameworks that data engineers consume, set the CI/CD gating policies that determine what merges and what doesn't, and lead the validation that determines when the platform is ready for production traffic. You will work in close partnership with the architect on spec-derived test conventions and with the data engineering team on the operational maturity of every component.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define and own the four-tier test framework: unit (per spec acceptance criterion), integration (within-layer composition), contract (cross-layer schema and behaviour), and acceptance (end-to-end scenarios). Establish the conventions that distinguish them and the CI gates that enforce them
* Establish the spec-to-test traceability standard. Every acceptance criterion in a unit spec must have at least one named test that verifies it; test names reference the AC ID by convention; CI enforces coverage. The traceability is regulatory-defensible by design
* Build and maintain the test infrastructure — fixture management (HL7v2, CCDA, CSV, FHIR samples organized by source and DLQ scenario), DBT test runners, FHIR validator integration, Mini Cluster Flink test harnesses, HAPI test server harnesses for FHIR-Repository interceptor work, end-to-end test orchestration
* Establish synthetic test data conventions — no real PHI in fixtures; structured-but-synthetic patient names, identifiers, dates; reusable patterns for multi-source linkage scenarios; coverage of edge cases (NULLs, ECI merges, late-arriving data, validation failures)
* Lead the load testing campaign — design the eight to ten scenarios that validate sustained 50K msg/sec ingest, 150K msg/sec peaks, full DBT refresh at billion-row scale, 1,000 concurrent Starburst queries, 5,000 req/sec FHIR API, MDM degradation behaviour, and reprocessing during steady state. Lead execution; report against acceptance criteria
* Lead the parallel-run validation framework — for the 30-60 day cutover period when the new platform ingests alongside the existing Health Data Engine, establish what data is compared between the two systems, what tolerances are accepted, what reconciliation reports are produced, and what triggers a rollback decision
* Define performance SLOs and monitoring strategy. Every component has measurable latency, throughput, and freshness budgets. Build dashboards that operators use during incidents and that establish trend baselines over time
* Define and enforce CI/CD test gates — what blocks PR merge (spec lint, AC coverage, unit tests, integration tests, lint/format), what runs nightly (full integration suite, contract tests, slow scenarios), what runs in stage before promotion (acceptance tests). Codify in pipeline configuration and runbooks
* Build out test automation for FHIR profile validation — every Bundle published is validated against US Core 6.1 in CI and in the runtime path. Establish the FHIR validator deployment, the profile pack management, and the test patterns that prove conformance
* Lead testing for the bidirectional FHIR flow — verifying loop prevention via origin tagging works under load, that the FHIR-Repository egress interceptor captures every client-originated change, that the loopback Flink job applies write-authority rules correctly, and that no echoes propagate
* Establish testing patterns for MDM integration — synthesizing match/no-match/multi-match scenarios, validating ECI assignment correctness, validating ECI\_MERGE and ECI\_SPLIT handling end-to-end, validating DLQ routing for MDM failures
* Lead validation of data quality at every layer — DBT test suites for CDM, freshness checks at every layer boundary, anomaly detection for ingestion patterns, governance integration for quality metric publication to Atlan
* Mentor data engineers on test authorship under the spec-driven development framework. Tests are part of every PR; their quality is part of the PR review; the QA lead sets the bar
* Participate in incident response and root cause analysis. Drive test additions that prevent recurrence — every production incident becomes a new acceptance criterion in the affected spec and a new test in the suite

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 8+ years of QA experience with at least 3-5 years focused on data quality, data warehousing, or data platform testing, and 2+ years in a lead or architect role
* Demonstrated experience defining and operating QA strategies for large-scale data platforms in cloud environments — preferably GCP
* Strong Python and SQL skills for test framework authorship. Familiarity with pytest and dbt-test conventions required
* Experience with data validation across batch, streaming (Kafka), and event-driven pipelines
* Experience with dbt — specifically dbt's native testing framework, dbt-expectations or dbt-utils packages, custom test authorship via macros, and source freshness checks
* Experience testing Iceberg or other open-table-format-backed warehouses — schema evolution edge cases, partition handling, snapshot semantics, and CoW vs MoR behavioral differences
* Experience with healthcare data quality testing — HL7v2 parsing edge cases, FHIR profile conformance validation, terminology binding validation, master data quality
* Experience designing and executing load tests for data platforms at scale — JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or custom load generators. Familiarity with realistic load profile design (not just throughput, but representative mix of operations)
* Experience with parallel-run validation and reconciliation between legacy and replacement data systems
* Strong CI/CD experience — GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Cloud Build. Ability to design pipeline gates and integrate test execution into PR and release workflows
* Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. The role works across engineering, architecture, governance, and customer stakeholder groups

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience with the HL7 FHIR validator, Inferno, or HAPI FHIR validation tooling
* Atlan experience for data quality metric publication and governance integration
* Experience with chaos engineering or resilience testing for streaming data systems
* Experience integrating spec-driven or contract-first frameworks with QA workflows
* Test management tools experience (TestRail, Zephyr, qTest)
* Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments — synthetic PHI generation, audit trail validation, regulatory test evidence
* QA or cloud platform certifications

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*

The Reconciliation Java Technical Lead will lead the transformation of the CEFS Recon platform into a technically robust, cloud‑native platform. The position is vital for shaping up the technical vision, strategy and execution of the Recon initiatives. The role is expected to define the Java micro‑service landscape, streaming pipelines, persistence strategy, CI/CD and cloud‑deployment model (Kubernetes/Docker), guaranteeing high availability, scalability, performance and security. Working in an international Clients base environment but also as part of an Offshore organization, the capacity to interact in a respectful and easy way with both his/her Clients, Management, and team to find compromises while guaranteeing the proper organization and seamless relations is a must.
  
  
This position requires strong leadership, communication, and adaptability to navigate the complexities of working in a globally distributed environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Ensure system reliability, scalability, stability and security by implementing appropriate design patterns and architectural principles.
* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and recommend enhancements to optimize performance.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices to drive innovation.
* Design the Java micro‑service landscape, CI/CD pipeline, container‑orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker) and infrastructure-as-code, and monitoring tools.
* Establish security‑by‑design patterns and embed them in all solutions.
* Ensure that all solutions are well-documented and align with industry’s best practices.
* Own API and message‑schema contracts for all inbound/outbound feeds, manage versioning and backward compatibility.
* Define data‑lineage, master‑data‑management and data‑quality controls required for auditability
* Conduct architectural and code reviews, apply security controls, enforce best practices, and mentor junior engineers – all in line with the organization’s architectural standards.
* Champion DevOps automation (shift‑left testing, shift‑right monitoring) and drive an “automation‑first” mindset to reduce manual hand‑offs.
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation, user manuals, SOPs and materials.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Proficiency in business analysis tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, MS Visio)
* Familiarity with software development methodologies
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives: DevSecOps adoption, automated contract testing, observability
* Quick to learn and adapt
* Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
* Good Team player
* Someone who could have long-term commitment with the team and organization

**Specific Qualifications**

* A proven experience in multi-expertise team management in an international environment,
* An experience in an Onshore/Offshore would be a key factor,

You will work within the client’s codebase and engineering standards, owning agreed deliverables from understanding requirements through deployment and handover.

* Document technical decisions and operational procedures, and provide knowledge transfer so the client’s team can maintain and operate the solution.

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience: 3–6 years of software development experience, with a strong focus on Python backend development in production.

* Strong Python skills and experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or a comparable framework, including API design and system integrations.

* Ability to understand unfamiliar codebases, troubleshoot issues, and contribute production-quality code.

* Experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, a cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and Docker, Git, CI/CD, and automated testing.

* Practical experience with RAG, LLM applications, or tool-calling workflows, including an understanding of retrieval, evaluation, and AI safety considerations.

* Comfort working within an embedded client team, clarifying ambiguous requirements, and taking ownership of agreed deliverables.

* Experience working within governed enterprise environments, including approved libraries and services, data access controls, and security review processes.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

* Good to have: agent orchestration frameworks, vector search tools, enterprise GenAI platforms, Kubernetes, or NoSQL databases.

* Good to have: Spark, Databricks, prior consulting or client-facing delivery, or experience in regulated domains such as financial services, healthcare, or the public sector.

* Opportunity to lead cutting-edge AI projects in a global consulting environment.

description:
Clearwater Analytics’ mission is to become the world’s most trusted and comprehensive technology platform for investment reporting, accounting, and analytics. With our team, you will partner with the most sophisticated and innovative institutional investors around the world. If you are infectiously passionate about what you do, intensely committed to clients, and driven by continuous innovation and improvement... We want you to apply!
  
  
We are looking for Java and Python developers to design and build scalable, cloud-native platforms for OTC and listed derivatives. You will work on trade capture, valuation, lifecycle events, risk, and post-trade processing across Interest Rate Derivatives (IRD), Credit Derivatives (CRD), FX Derivatives (FXD), and related asset classes. You will work closely with product, quants, and operations to turn complex financial workflows into reliable, well-designed software.

* Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services for derivative trade lifecycle management, valuation, pricing, risk, collateral, and reporting.

* Model and process derivative products (swaps, swaptions, caps/floors, CDS, FX forwards/options/NDFs) and their lifecycle events (resets, fixings, amendments, novations, terminations, compressions).
* Write clean, testable, well-documented code, and take part in code and design reviews.
* Improve the performance, resilience, and observability of production systems, and help resolve complex production issues.
* Mentor junior engineers and help raise engineering standards (senior profiles).

* 6–12 years of software development experience, with at least 2 years in derivative asset classes (IRD, CRD, FXD, or equivalent).
* Strong hands-on skills in Java (8/11/17+) and/or Python 3.x. Working knowledge of both is a plus.
* Hands-on cloud development experience on AWS including containers (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Excellent design skills: OOP, SOLID, design patterns, domain-driven design, microservices, event-driven architecture, and REST/gRPC API design.
* Working knowledge of derivative concepts: pricing and valuation basics,curves, trade lifecycle, and clearing/margining.
* Proficiency with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, etc.) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
* Strong unit, integration, and automated testing practices.
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills, and the ability to work with business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with frameworks such as Spring Boot and FastAPI.
* Experience with distributed computing and low-latency design
* Exposure to observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and Agile/DevOps practices.
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field. Certifications such as CFA, FRM are a plus.

The individual will act as a quality advocate, providing guidance on QA processes, improving testing efficiency, and ensuring adherence to industry standards and best practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of end-to-end QA activities, including requirement analysis, test planning, execution, and reporting.
* Collaborate with Technology Leads, Product Managers, and Business Teams to align testing strategies with business goals.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test cases, particularly for APIs and backend systems.
* Define and implement test strategies, frameworks, and processes to improve overall testing efficiency and coverage.
* Perform manual and automated testing for enterprise-class, financial, middleware, and backend applications.
* Analyze complex system behaviors and develop detailed test plans to ensure comprehensive validation.
* Execute API testing using tools like Postman and automate using frameworks such as Rest Assured with Java.
* Conduct UI testing and automation (where applicable) using tools like Selenium WebDriver.
* Write and execute SQL queries for data validation and backend verification.
* Debug application issues using server logs and backend diagnostics.
* Coordinate testing activities across application enhancements and technical operations.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies such as stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
* Track defects, manage test cases, and report issues using tools like JIRA, ALM, TestRail, or X-Ray.
* Communicate project status updates, including risks, progress, KPIs, and quality metrics to stakeholders.

**Key Skills, Experience And Competencies**

* 5–8 years of experience in Quality Assurance and Testing, with at least 2 years of hands-on automation experience.
* Strong expertise in manual testing of enterprise and financial applications, including middleware and backend systems.
* Proficiency in API testing tools such as Postman and SOAP UI.
* Hands-on experience in API automation using Rest Assured with Java.
* Familiarity with UI testing and automation tools like Selenium WebDriver.
* Strong knowledge of SQL for writing and understanding complex queries and stored procedures.
* Experience working with Unix/Linux environments.
* Exposure to backend automation, batch job testing, and log-based debugging.
* Good understanding of Agile methodologies and QA best practices.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, ALM, TestRail, X-Ray).
* Knowledge of AWS or cloud platforms is an added advantage.
* Understanding of financial systems, payment gateways, e-wallets, and related workflows.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and ownership mindset.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as within a team environment.
* Working knowledge on Agentic AI with Github Co-pilot or relevant such AI tool.

**Qualifications (if Required)**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications in QA, Automation Testing, or Agile methodologies are a plus.

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.
  
  
Additional information
  
  
**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
* Snacks & Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.

description:

Ateme is looking for a
**permanent AI Solutions & Automation Engineer**
to design, develop, and deploy internal tools that reduce repetitive tasks, streamline access to information, and improve team efficiency, particularly across Sales, Pre-Sales, Support, Product, and Operations.
  
  
Your role will sit at the intersection of full-stack development, generative AI, automation, and business understanding. You will work from real business needs to develop reliable, measurable solutions that are easy for teams to adopt.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and prioritize use cases: Work directly with business teams to understand their processes, identify low-value or repetitive tasks, and define the expected benefits.
* Prototype quickly: Design proofs of concept and usage-focused MVPs, test them with users, and iterate based on feedback.
* Develop end-to-end internal tools: Build user interfaces, backend services, workflows, agents, and integrations through to operational deployment.
* Connect enterprise systems: Integrate solutions with Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, and other approved data sources while respecting access rights and permissions.
* Industrialize solutions: Implement testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, version management, support, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure security and responsible AI: Apply data protection, confidentiality, traceability, human oversight, and risk management requirements.
* Measure impact: Define adoption, quality, and operational efficiency metrics with business teams and track the value delivered after deployment.
* Build reusable solutions: Document components and agents, avoid duplication, and contribute to a shared architecture that enables solutions to be reused across multiple teams.

**Examples of Solutions you may build**

* Assistants for meeting preparation, meeting summaries, and action tracking.
* Intelligent search across commercial and technical documentation.
* Automation of RFP responses and generation of scoping documents.
* Tools to support proposal preparation, opportunity tracking, and consolidation of information from multiple sources.
* Support agents capable of suggesting contextualized resolutions and enriching the knowledge base.
* Simple internal applications to automate checks, calculations, reporting, and recurring workflows.

**Required Skills and Experience**
You hold a Master’s degree (Bac+5), engineering degree, or equivalent qualification, and have at least 5 years of relevant experience in application development, automation, or the implementation of AI solutions in an enterprise environment.
  
  

* Full-stack development: Python and/or TypeScript, REST APIs, web applications, databases, and user-focused interface design.
* Generative AI and agents: LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, semantic search, tool calling, orchestration, and response quality evaluation.
* Integration: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, SSO, enterprise APIs and connectors, identity and permission management.
* Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, monitoring, and deployment on cloud or internal platforms.
* Product thinking: Ability to start from a business need, define an MVP, balance simplicity and robustness, and support user adoption.
* Security & governance: Good practices in data protection, secrets management, auditability, human oversight, and documentation.

**Additionall Skills that would be an advantage**

* Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI, or Azure OpenAI.
* Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Dataverse, or Fabric.
* Agent interoperability protocols and standards, particularly MCP.
* Experience in media, video, B2B SaaS, or enterprise software environments.
* UX practices, change management, and user training.

**How your work matters**
Curiosity, pragmatism, autonomy, and a results-oriented mindset are essential. You enjoy understanding how people actually work, simplifying complex problems, and delivering useful solutions.
  
  
You can clearly explain your decisions, collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, experiment quickly without compromising security, and understand that a solution only creates value when people actually use it.
  
  
**Location**
We consider different locations in Europe and Asia (our offices locations) but we do not consider 100% remote. This job is not eligible for mobility or relocation opportunities.
  
  
At Ateme,
**onboarding**
is much more than a process. It is a complete experience designed to set you up for success: immersive training, regular meetings with your manager and HR, a collaborative culture, and stimulating projects.
  
  
Join us for a rewarding professional journey where your development and success matter.
  
  
**Compensation & Benefits**

* Compensation based on experience
* Hybrid working model
* Bonuses: performance bonus, employee referral bonus, etc.
* Access to our internal training platform, including video technologies, Kubernetes, AWS, and more
* International collaboration with Business, IT, Product, R&D, and Security teams

To learn more about Ateme, visit our corporate website:
  
  
**www.ateme.com**

description:

cerebre is on a mission to build the data foundation of the physical world. We offer a live intelligence map of a facilities – built from schematics to power AI. Often called the “brain” of the digital twin, cerebre helps engineers, data scientists, and business teams understand data within the context of the plant.

cerebre is a global team of engineers, scientists, innovators, and explorers united by a mission to help the world’s largest manufacturing facilities build and use intelligence.
  
  
Our development team is made up of world-class engineers who design and deliver novel solutions. This is an opportunity to join a market-leading team that is changing how the industrial world works.

We are looking for a Test Engineer to elevate our software quality to the next level. As a member of our technology team, you will work daily with our world-class engineers. * Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, to understand requirements, discuss testing strategies, and ensure alignment on quality goals.

* Experience in software testing, including test design, test case creation, and defect management

title: Quality Engineering - Specialist
description:
**Excited to grow your career?**
We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
Nasdaq Technology is looking for a passionate
**Quality Engineer -Specialist**
focused on test automation for the Eclipse Intelligence Platform (EIP). If innovation and quality drive you forward, this is the place for you!
  
  
As a Quality Engineer Specialist, you will be a key member of a cross-functional team, ensuring the quality and reliability of critical data solutions for financial markets around the globe. You will work with cutting-edge technologies including Java, AWS, Kubernetes, and modern microservices architecture to build comprehensive test automation frameworks and strategies.
  
  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to work in a strong experienced team delivering complex technology solutions to our external clients. You will work with and learn from subject matter experts and have the opportunity to take on more responsibility and progress within the quality engineering team.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing (Role Responsibilities)**

* Test Automation Framework Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for EIP platform microservices
* API & Integration Testing: Create comprehensive automated test suites for RESTful APIs, event-driven architecture (SNS/SQS), and microservices integration
* Performance & Load Testing: Design and implement performance testing strategies, execute load tests, and analyze system behavior under various conditions
* CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into GitLab CI/CD pipelines, ensuring quality gates are enforced throughout the deployment process
* Test Strategy & Planning: Collaborate with development teams to define test strategies, create test plans, and ensure comprehensive test coverage
* Debugging & Analysis: Analyze logs, metrics, and traces using observability tools to identify root causes of test failures and production issues
* Documentation & Reporting: Document test cases, test results, and quality metrics; provide regular status reports to stakeholders
* Quality Advocacy: Work closely with developers to improve testability, promote quality best practices, and foster a quality-first culture

**We Expect You To Have (Minimum Qualifications)**
**Core Testing Skills:**

* 5-7 years of experience in software quality engineering with strong focus on test automation
* Test Automation Expertise: Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks (JUnit, TestNG, REST Assured, Playwright, Selenium)
* Programming Skills: Proficiency in any programming language Java/Python. Kotlin experience is a strong plus
* API Testing: Deep expertise in RESTful API testing, including authentication, authorization, and data validation

**Technical Skills:**

* Database Testing: Strong SQL skills for data validation and query testing (PostgreSQL, Redshift)
* Performance Testing: Experience with performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, K6, or similar)
* CI/CD: Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI preferred)
* Containerization: Understanding of Docker and Kubernetes for testing containerized applications
* Linux & Scripting: Proficiency with Linux commands and Bash scripting for test automation

**Soft Skills:**

* Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to troubleshoot complex issues and identify root causes
* Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with developers, product owners, and stakeholders
* Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to quality assurance standards
* Continuous Learning: Passion for learning new testing tools, technologies, and methodologies
* Adaptability: Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced agile environment with changing priorities
* Quality Advocacy: Drive to promote quality practices and improve overall software quality

**Education:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent work experience

**It Would Be Great If You Have (Preferred Qualifications)**

* AWS Experience: Hands-on experience testing AWS services (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, SNS, SQS, EKS, Redshift)
* Kotlin Programming: Experience with Kotlin for test development
* SaaS Testing Experience: Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS platform testing challenges
* Event-Driven Architecture: Experience testing Kafka, SNS/SQS, or other messaging systems
* Data Platform Knowledge: Understanding of Data Lakes, Data Warehousing, and big data technologies
* Infrastructure-as-Code Testing: Experience validating Terraform or CloudFormation templates
* Observability Tools: Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and tracing tools (CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, etc.)
* Security Testing: Understanding of authentication/authorization testing, IAM policies, and secrets management
* Chaos Engineering: Experience with fault injection and resilience testing
* Financial Industry Knowledge: Curiosity about financial markets, products, and services that Nasdaq offers

**Does It Sound Like You?**
As the selection process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible. We will get back to you in 2-3 weeks.
  
  
**Come As You Are**
Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, color, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.
  
  
Nasdaq is a leading global provider of trading, clearing, exchange technology, listing, information, and public company services. As the creator of the world's first electronic stock market, its technology powers more than 100 marketplaces in 50 countries. Nasdaq is home to over 4,000 total listings with a market value of approximately $12 trillion.
  
  
**Come as You Are**
Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.
  
  
We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

title: Operating System Engineer
description:
Required Background and Prior Experience

We are seeking a hands-on engineer who has previously built and supported production healthcare software comparable to VerityOS.

1. Relevant healthcare product experience — mandatory

The candidate must have personally developed substantial components of a live U.S. healthcare product involving one or more of the following:

\* Practice management.

\* Medical billing and revenue cycle management.

\* EHR-connected patient engagement and operational workflows.

The product must have been used by real healthcare organizations. Coursework, prototypes, chatbot demonstrations, and internal proof-of-concept projects alone do not qualify.

2. Billing and RCM engineering experience — mandatory

The candidate must have hands-on experience implementing healthcare billing workflows, including:

\* Claim creation/submission and acknowledgment or rejection handling.

\* Electronic remittance or EOB processing and payment posting.

\* Denial management and accounts-receivable workflows.

\* Patient balances, adjustments, and reconciliation.

They must understand the distinction between charges, claims, payments, adjustments, and patient responsibility, and explain how their system prevented duplicate transactions and preserved financial history.

They do not need to have built every billing component independently, but must clearly identify the components they personally implemented.

3. EHR or healthcare-system integration experience — mandatory

The candidate must have delivered at least one production integration with an EHR, practice-management system, or healthcare clearinghouse.

Relevant experience includes approved APIs, FHIR, HL7, healthcare transaction interfaces, or secure data exchanges.

They must demonstrate experience with patient matching, synchronization, conflicting updates, failed transactions, and reconciliation. General API experience alone is insufficient.

4. Secure application architecture — mandatory

The candidate must have implemented:

\* Role-based permissions and server-side access controls.

\* Audit trails and sensitive-data protection.

\* Separation of customer organizations’ data.

\* Secure credential management.

\* Backup, recovery, monitoring, and incident handling.

Experience with a platform serving multiple independent practices or customer organizations is strongly preferred.

5. Hands-on full-stack development — mandatory

The candidate must be able to personally design databases, develop backend services and user interfaces, write meaningful tests, deploy applications, and troubleshoot production issues.

This is a building role, not solely a project-management, consulting, or architecture role.

6. Production ownership — mandatory

The candidate must have supported a product after launch, including resolving incidents, releasing upgrades, managing database changes, and maintaining integrations.

They should be able to describe a significant production failure, its impact, how it was resolved, and what was changed to prevent recurrence.

7. Workflow automation experience — mandatory

The candidate must have built workflows involving task assignment, statuses, deadlines, escalation, document handling, and external-system events.

They must understand how to handle retries, duplicate events, incomplete information, and human review.

8. AI and communications experience — strongly preferred

Preference will be given to candidates who have deployed:

\* AI document extraction with validation.

\* Tool-using AI agents with defined permissions and human handoff.

\* Voice agents or telephony integrations.

\* Two-way SMS, e-fax, or secure patient messaging.

Candidates must distinguish production deployments from experimental projects.

9. Patient-facing and specialty experience — preferred

Relevant additional experience includes patient portals, caregiver access, scheduling, authorization workflows, procedure-resource scheduling, infusions, or other specialty-practice operations.

Neurology experience is valuable but not mandatory.

Evidence required with the application

Please provide two relevant project examples. For each, describe:

\* The product and type of healthcare organization it served.

\* Whether it reached production and how long you supported it.

\* Your exact role and the components you personally built.

\* EHRs, clearinghouses, or communications systems integrated.

\* The scale of deployment, where disclosure is permitted.

\* A difficult technical problem and how you resolved it.

\* A professional reference who can verify your contribution.

Confidential client names may be withheld initially. Use anonymized descriptions and synthetic data; do not disclose patient information or proprietary code.

description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. **About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT)

title: IBM BPM Devloper
description:
**Role: IBM BPM Developer/BAW Developer**

**Location: Goregaon East, Mumbai (local candidates only)**

**Job Type: Fulltime**

**Experience: 2+ years**

**Budget: Upto 9 LPA**

**Immediate to 30 Days notice only**

**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled IBM BPM / BAW Developer with a strong background in Java/JEE enterprise application development and relational databases. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing end-to-end process automation workflows.

A critical component of this role involves utilizing IBM Integration Designer (IID) to build Advanced Integration Services (AIS), BPEL processes, and mediation flows that bridge our workflow engine with complex enterprise backend systems. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between process modelling (Process Designer) and complex backend enterprise integration (IID/Java/SQL).

**Key Responsibilities**

1.
**Process Automation & Workflow Development**

* Design, develop, and implement end-to-end process models using IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) / IBM BPM (Process Designer).
* Create and maintain standard/advanced client-side human services, coach views, and custom UI components using JavaScript/CSS.
* Implement complex process logic, tracking groups, timers, gateways, and UCA (Undercover Agents) event handling.

2.
**Advanced Integration & Middleware (IID)**

* Utilize IBM Integration Designer (IID) to develop robust Advanced Integration Services (AIS), Service Component Architecture (SCA) modules, and BPEL (Business Process Execution Language) processes.
* Design and configure custom Mediation Flows, data transformations (XSLT/BO Maps), and adapters (JDBC, Flat File, Web Services) within IID.
* Build, expose, and consume secure corporate enterprise web services (REST APIs and SOAP/WSDL protocols) using XML and JSON data mapping.

3.
**Java Stack & Core Backend Customization**

* Develop custom server-side plugins, integration components, and utility classes using Core Java / JEE to handle complex business logic outside standard out-of-the-box BPM capabilities.
* Write clean, maintainable enterprise Java code, managing object mappings, dependency injection, and advanced multithreaded processing configurations.

4.
**Database & Performance Optimization**

* Write complex, high-performance SQL queries, stored procedures, triggers, and functions to interact with enterprise relational databases (e.g., Oracle, IBM DB2, or MS SQL Server).
* Design data schemas and optimize database interactions within BPM integration services to minimize latency and avoid process blocking.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve performance bottlenecks across the BPM runtime, IID SCA modules, and backend database layers.

**Required Technical Skills & Qualifications**

* BPM Platform: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience explicitly working with IBM BAW (25.x) ecosystems.
* Integration Tooling: Proven expertise with IBM Integration Designer (IID) building advanced SOA-based integration layers and long-running BPEL flows.
* Java Stack: Strong programming proficiency in Core Java, JEE, Hibernate/JPA, and web services infrastructure.
* Database Stack: Solid working knowledge of relational database management systems (RDBMS) with excellent SQL query optimization and stored procedure debugging skills.
* Web Technologies: Comprehensive understanding of Web Services (RESTful APIs, SOAP, WSDL), data exchange formats (XML, XSD, JSON), and frontend languages (JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3).
* Methodology: Strong experience working within an Agile/Scrum development model.

**Soft Skills & Educational Background**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.
* Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and debugging skills to trace data across decoupled components (Process Center \rightarrow Advanced Integration Layer / rightarrow DB Engine).
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with business analysts, system architects, and project stakeholders.

**Preferred Certifications (Good to Have)**

* IBM Certified Application Developer - Business Automation Workflow / BPM
* Oracle Certified Associate/Professional Java Programmer (OCAJP / OCPJP)

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

  
  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  
  

**About the Role**

  

As a QA Automation Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of quality across a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo digital health platform. You will build the automated test framework hands-on, define expected behaviour, and help improve reliability from an existing baseline where test coverage and pass rates need strengthening.

  

You will work with an engineering team of 4, collaborating to understand how the system should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives. The role is predominantly hands-on and independent, with shared responsibility for product quality.

  

The first phase will involve speaking with stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and building out automation that enables faster, safer releases.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Own the quality process end to end and build the automated test framework hands-on.
  
* Understand how a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo system works and how it should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives.
  
* Ask the right questions and document expected behaviour where inherited documentation is partly out of date.
  
* Author English-readable scenarios in Cucumber and Gherkin.
  
* Build automation in JavaScript and TypeScript.
  
* Drive the UI through a page object model.
  
* Add data-test-ids to React code where missing.
  
* Validate correct database state using SQL.
  
* Maintain the automated tests as new features arrive.
  
* Feed into requirements upfront as new features are planned.
  
* Flag compliance, regulatory and security implications.
  
* Run exploratory testing to identify where the product behaves incorrectly.
  
* Improve reliability and enable faster, safer releases through automation.
  
* Reproduce multi-step defects precisely and identify edge cases.
  
* Build a repeatable, documented QA process from an unreliable baseline.
  
* Work out how the system should behave across multiple user perspectives and how it might break.
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* 4+ years of experience in QA or test automation, hands-on with TypeScript or JavaScript.
  
* 4+ years of hands-on test automation coding in TypeScript or JavaScript.
  
* 2+ years of BDD test authoring with Cucumber and Gherkin.
  
* 3+ years of web UI test automation using a page object model, preferably with Playwright.
  
* 2+ years of end-to-end QA ownership, including defining, documenting, building and maintaining tests.
  
* 3+ years of requirements analysis and stakeholder communication.
  
* 2+ years of SQL querying to validate database state, using MySQL or PostgreSQL.
  
* 3+ years of exploratory testing and precise multi-step defect reproduction.
  
* Ability to drive automation and own the build with limited direction.
  
* Strong detail orientation, including the ability to spot edge cases and gaps in specifications.
  
* Hands-on JavaScript or TypeScript automation coding is non-negotiable; willingness to learn is not sufficient.
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Mobile app testing and automation experience, especially with Flutter apps.
  
* Experience with Appium or Flutter integration\_test.
  
* Experience reading and working with React front-end code.
  
* Experience with Angular, Vue or another modern JavaScript framework.
  
* Security and regulatory awareness, including ISO 27001, GDPR or NHS DTAC.
  
* Experience in another regulated or audited environment.
  
* ISO 13485 medical-device regulated-environment testing.
  
* Experience in an adjacent regulated domain such as medtech, fintech or NHS/DTAC.
  
* Healthtech or digital health domain experience.
  
* Comfort using AI in the engineering workflow.
  

  
**Benefits**
  

  
* Fixed Shifts: 12:00 PM - 9:30 PM IST (Summer) | 1:00 PM - 10:30 PM IST (Winter)
  
* No Weekend Work: Real work-life balance, not just words
  
* Day 1 Benefits: Laptop and full medical insurance provided
  
* Support That Matters:Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared
  
* True Belonging: A long-term career where your contributions are valued

title: Specialist – Test Automation (Tosca)
